source.title: WCA Asian Championship 2026 Cancellation (October 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Major Championships Team (WMCT) regrets to announce that the WCA Asian Championship 2026 will not take place.

After the [update made in March](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-asian-championship-2026-update-march-2026), the WMCT and the WCA Board explored other possibilities for  an alternative 2026 Asian Championship location. These conversations were ultimately unsuccessful, resulting in the unfortunate cancellation of the competition entirely.

<!-- break -->
We understand the disappointment that this announcement brings, and especially apologize to competitors living in Asia, who will not have a continental championship in their region in 2026.

Hosting a successful Asian Championship in 2028 is a top priority for the WMCT, and we are revising our processes to ensure the stability of our major championships moving forward. The WMCT would like to express our commitment to bringing a high-quality championship experience to our Asian speedcubing community in 2028 and beyond.

translation.title: 2026 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛取消公告（2026 年 10 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 大型锦标赛组（WMCT）遗憾地宣布，2026 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛将不再举办。

在[今年 3 月发布最新进展](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-asian-championship-2026-update-march-2026)之后，WMCT 与 WCA 董事会探讨了在其他地点举办 2026 年亚洲锦标赛的可能性。这些商谈最终未能取得成果，遗憾的是，本届比赛因此完全取消。

我们理解这一消息让大家失望，尤其要向生活在亚洲的选手致歉：2026 年，亚洲将没有本地区的洲际锦标赛。

成功举办 2028 年亚洲锦标赛是 WMCT 的首要任务之一。我们正在修订相关流程，以确保今后的大型锦标赛能够稳定举办。WMCT 将致力于在 2028 年及以后，为亚洲速拧社群带来高质量的锦标赛体验。
